description: A utility class for date-related operations such as formatting dates, generating timestamps, adding days to current date, and processing posted dates from HTTP requests.

classes.name: DateUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static and instance methods for date formatting, parsing, and manipulation.

methods.name: generateTimeStamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp in the format 'yyyyMMddHHmmSS'.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string using a default date format.

methods.name: formatYear
methods.description: Formats a Date object to a year string based on the default date format for year.

methods.name: formatLongDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a long date string format.

methods.name: formatDateMonthString
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a month-specific string using the default date format.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object using the default date format.

methods.name: addDaysToCurrentDate
methods.description: Returns a Date object offset by a specified number of days from the current date.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date and time as a Date object.

methods.name: getPresentDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getPresentYear
methods.description: Returns the current year as a string.

methods.name: processPostedDates
methods.description: Processes 'startdate' and 'enddate' parameters from an HTTP request, parsing them into Date objects.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date as stored in the object.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date as stored in the object.
